posts.text:
Question: I've heard from European leaders that, with Trump, they've learned the power of No. Do you see that reaping benefits?

EU MP @brandobenifei: “Trump is often testing us. He wants to see how much the EU is united in saying we demand respect….but we need to be firmer.”
posts.summary: EU must stand united and firm against Trump's demands

Question: NY’s mayor is not the only U.S. politician who has criticized the conduct of the war in Gaza. Are you concerned Israel is losing US support?

@dannydanon: “Let me surprise you. It is legitimate to criticize Israel…So we are open for criticism and we don't have to agree all the time with our allies. But you should use the same standards that you use in any other cases.“
posts.summary: Israeli official welcomes legitimate criticism of Gaza war conduct

Question: Can you imagine Canada imposing tariffs on the US if US wildfire smoke went north?
